items.title: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
items.title_zh: 加州议会一致通过 Linux 年龄验证法豁免
items.summary: California lawmakers unanimously passed AB 1856, which excludes open-source operating systems from the state's upcoming Digital Age Assurance Act, Tom's Hardware reports.

items.title: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会在 ProtectEU 战略中重推加密后门
items.summary: The European Commission's ProtectEU strategy targets access to encrypted data and would expand Europol's powers and cross-border intelligence sharing, according to Reclaim The Net.

items.title: The shrinking landscape of linguistic diversity in the age of LLMs
items.title_zh: LLM 时代日渐萎缩的语言多样性
items.summary: A Nature Human Behaviour study by Sourati et al. finds that variance in writing complexity dropped across social media, news and scientific writing after ChatGPT's release, a shift from individuality toward uniformity. The authors say LLM polishing strips cues to gender, age, ideology and moral values.

items.title: Claude Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default
items.title_zh: Claude 会话链接默认附加到提交信息与 PR 描述
items.summary: A feature request filed against Anthropic's Claude Code repository concerns Claude session URLs being appended to commit messages and pull request descriptions by default.

items.title: How to build a diffusion language model
items.title_zh: 如何构建扩散语言模型
items.summary: A blog post introduces diffusion language models and the research behind them, covering the building blocks of recent open-source models from simple masking diffusion through iterative refinement, post-training and variable-length generation, adapted from ICLR 2026 and MLSS 2026 talks.

items.title: Bug Blindness
items.title_zh: Bug 盲视
items.summary: Dan Luu argues that most people encounter the same software bugs he does but fail to notice them, and that programmers can learn to overcome this “bug blindness” once bugs are pointed out to them over time.

items.title: FreeCORE TrueNAS Core – Continued
items.title_zh: FreeCORE：TrueNAS CORE 的延续
items.summary: FreeCORE continues TrueNAS CORE 13.3 as an independently maintained operating system for NAS appliances, offering in-place upgrades to FreeCORE 15.0.

items.title: No country for mediocre mathematicians
items.title_zh: 没有平庸数学家的容身之地
items.summary: A Substack essay reflects on how communicating mathematics depends on simplifying “lies” told to students and funders, and on the author's own path to a PhD in arithmetic geometry.

items.title: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
items.title_zh: 加州议会一致通过 Linux 年龄验证法豁免
items.summary: California lawmakers unanimously passed AB 1856, which excludes open-source operating systems from the state's upcoming Digital Age Assurance Act, Tom's Hardware reports.

items.title: Smartphone LED detects hidden cameras with AI
items.title_zh: 智能手机 LED 结合 AI 探测隐藏摄像头
items.summary: KAIST's SweepLED system uses a smartphone LED and AI to detect hidden cameras, reaching 94% accuracy with a device that costs about 10,000 won, according to Chosun.

items.title: Longest Straight Line Paths on Water or Land on the Earth (2018)
items.title_zh: 地球上最长直线水路与陆路（2018）
items.summary: A 2018 paper presents a branch-and-bound method for computing the longest distance one can sail without hitting land, and the converse problem of the longest drive without encountering a major body of water.

items.title: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.title_zh: QubesOS：copy-to-VM 错误上报通道可致任意代码执行
items.summary: The Qubes OS project published Qubes Security Bulletin 118, describing Dom0 arbitrary code execution in qvm-copy-to-vm error reporting; the bulletin is reproduced with cryptographic signatures and verification instructions.

items.title: Brits would quite like their private messages to stay private
items.title_zh: 英国人希望自己的私信保持私密
items.summary: Polling reported by The Register finds that two-thirds of Britons do not trust the current government, or any future one, with access to their encrypted chats.

items.title: No AI Fridays
items.title_zh: 无 AI 星期五
items.summary: A website proposes “No AI Fridays”, a weekly ritual in which software teams unplug from AI coding assistants to prevent skill atrophy and rediscover the joy of craftsmanship.

items.title: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
items.title_zh: METR 与 Redwood 对 HuggingFace 被黑事件的复盘
items.summary: A commentary post examines METR and Redwood's postmortem of the HuggingFace hack, following the author's earlier coverage of OpenAI's technical report, which he says contained one key new fact and concrete steps OpenAI will take to strengthen alignment.

items.title: Europe's summer drought is so extreme that desertification is a growing threat
items.title_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱极端，荒漠化威胁加剧
items.summary: Fortune reports that Europe's summer drought is extreme enough for desertification to become a growing threat, with around 99% of Hungary's land under severe or extreme drought conditions.

items.title: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会在 ProtectEU 战略中重推加密后门
items.summary: The European Commission's ProtectEU strategy targets access to encrypted data and would expand Europol's powers and cross-border intelligence sharing, according to Reclaim The Net.

items.title: Startup Anti-Patterns
items.title_zh: 创业公司反模式
items.summary: An essay series introduces startup anti-patterns — commonly used processes or structures that appear to be appropriate responses but ultimately cause more harm than good — crediting Simeon Simeonov's 2013 introduction to the idea.

items.title: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.title_zh: Omarchy：任意用户进程可提权至 root
items.summary: A security write-up reports that Omarchy's default Docker configuration allowed essentially every program in a user's desktop session to escalate to root without a password, sudo or privilege prompt; the configuration has since been patched and users are told to update to 4.0.1.

items.title: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
items.title_zh: Haiku R1/beta6 发布
items.summary: The Haiku project released Haiku R1/beta6 about two years after the previous beta and roughly a week after the operating system's 25th birthday.

items.title: Coordination Headwind: How Organizations Are Like Slime Molds
items.title_zh: 协调逆风：组织为何像黏菌
items.summary: An emoji flipbook presentation by Alex Komoroske explores how dysfunctional organizational dynamics arise even when the individuals involved are well behaved.

items.title: Cheap GPS jammers are filling the world with navigation dead zones
items.title_zh: 廉价 GPS 干扰器正在制造全球导航盲区
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that cheap GPS jammers are filling the world with navigation dead zones.

items.title: qunqin24/Pulse
items.title_zh: qunqin24/Pulse：AI 编程工具额度监控
items.summary: Pulse is a free, open-source macOS monitor that sits at the edge of the screen and shows how much usage remains across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and more than 70 other AI coding tools; it is written in Swift.

items.title: sharptoolbox/ontology-driven-dev
items.title_zh: sharptoolbox/ontology-driven-dev：本体驱动业务系统开发技能
items.summary: This repository packages an ontology-driven development skill that moves from requirement discovery through ontology modeling to application building, built on seven-model ontology YAML and a code-PaaS base, and supporting WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: himdo/Fable-2-Recomp
items.title_zh: himdo/Fable-2-Recomp
items.summary: Fable-2-Recomp is a C++ project listed among GitHub's trending repositories.

items.title: Merserk/dlss5-visual-enhancer
items.title_zh: Merserk/dlss5-visual-enhancer：DLSS 5 图像与视频增强
items.summary: A C++ project that applies DLSS 5 neural rendering to images and video, with frame generation, RTX Video Super Resolution, HDR and color grading.

items.title: NODIX-TECH/DLSS-5-MANAGER
items.title_zh: NODIX-TECH/DLSS-5-MANAGER：DLSS 5 管理器
items.summary: A project billed as the first DLSS 5 manager, written in F#.

items.title: Observal/Axl
items.title_zh: Observal/Axl
items.summary: Observal/Axl is a TypeScript project listed among GitHub's trending repositories.

items.title: aardappel/goose
items.title_zh: aardappel/goose：Goose 编程语言
items.summary: Goose is a programming language written in C++, according to its GitHub repository.

items.title: OnyxAxisOwO/ObsidianArc
items.title_zh: OnyxAxisOwO/ObsidianArc：自托管 AI 平台
items.summary: ObsidianArc is a self-hosted AI platform with a Go server, multi-provider routing, usage tracking and an admin console, offering both chat and agentic work modes.

items.title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
items.title_zh: 面向单 GPU 大模型推理的预算感知压缩流水线：方法、权衡与耦合效应
items.summary: Casts single-GPU inference of 70B-parameter models as a budget-aware design problem and studies how pruning, quantization and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Guided by these coupling results, it assembles a pipeline that compresses a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustains about 57 tokens/s on 10k-token prompts on a single A40, and keeps absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks.

items.title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
items.title_zh: Pak3H：用人工语境化的乌尔都语基准评估 LLM 对齐中文化错配的代价
items.summary: Introduces Pak3H, described as the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for helpfulness, harmlessness and honesty alignment, built through manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post-editing. Zero-shot evaluations across open and proprietary models reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps, with helpfulness win rates declining, harmlessness guardrails breaking down against regional risks, and honesty metrics degrading under localized factual constraints.

items.title: How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account
items.title_zh: LLM 智能体中的世界模型与策略如何组合？谱分析与行为分析的联合视角
items.summary: Uses controlled experiments combining next-state world-model training and reward-maximizing policy training to study how these components compose in LLM agents. It finds world-model updates are low-rank and share an input-feature subspace with policy updates while writing to nearly orthogonal output directions, and that sequential training explores more broadly and is more robust under projection interventions; training-free merging and an online world-model loss both improve over the baseline.

items.title: TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film
items.title_zh: TAKE 85：在 85 小时影片中测试视听导演意图理解
items.summary: Introduces TAKE 85, a benchmark of 398 short films totaling 85 hours with expert-verified question-answer pairs for understanding directorial intent across global and fine-grained visual and audio cues. Experiments show state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs describe events and narratives accurately but consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions, with the strongest model reaching only 58 out of 100.

items.title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
items.title_zh: 分类器何时能帮助 LLM？面向信用违约预测的分类器引导提示与混合分类器-LLM 模型
items.summary: Studies how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction, distinguishing instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. On the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raised recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032, and adding the predicted probability raised the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78 while retaining higher recall than a random forest.

items.title: A Lightweight Phenology-Aware YOLOv5 Framework for Tomato Growth Stage Detection in Resource-Constrained Bhutanese Greenhouse Environments
items.title_zh: 面向资源受限不丹温室环境的轻量物候感知 YOLOv5 番茄生长阶段检测框架
items.summary: Proposes Pheno-Lite + ECA, a lightweight phenology-aware detector derived from Ultralytics YOLOv5 for tomato growth-stage recognition, trained on 2,464 annotated images collected in Bhutan and from public sources. The model reports 90.6% precision, 88.8% recall and 92.6% mAP@50 with 4.0 million parameters and 10.9 GFLOPs at 640x640 resolution.
